basis.need: Member_002 reports (event 20, member claim) having inspected core.py and the buggy `_check_required_columns` message, and explicitly prefers authoring the scope_2 tests/CHANGELOG package. Observed: the v2 public test run failed 4 tests (event 21) and pkg_tests_release has no author and no reviewer. A dependency is added so the scope_2 tests/CHANGELOG target the corrected message wording from the scope_1 fix.
basis.expected_benefit: Hypothesis: separating authoring surfaces (core fix by member_001, tests/CHANGELOG by member_002) yields independent, cross-reviewed packages and lets the scope_2 tests be written against the corrected missing-column message, rather than encoding the current misleading text. Sequencing via the added dependency reduces rework of test expectations.
basis.switch_cost: Transfer of remaining scope_2 work to member_002 (interview/offer-accept flow) plus a new dependency edge which serializes scope_2 behind scope_1; member_001 loses an easy low-context package. Also both members must interleave coordination, so the benefit is not guaranteed.
